walls.note: Long front of the monument: RoMaVo photographs 1 and 3 (CC0) and Ceescamel 2025 B, F (CC0) in artifacts/landmark-refs/slavernijmonument/.

items.where: huge bronze figure rising from the platform and bending over, its long head pointing like a beak
items.how: six tapered segments on spine points read off RoMaVo 1 (88 px per metre against the 11 m platform), round joints, the head sweeping back west into a 4.5 m beak with a short lower jaw and a hanging arm; the previous builder had the beak pointing east, which the photographs contradict; the rough cast surface is omitted

items.where: second tall bronze figure by a post with arms raised and hair streaming
items.how: square post 0.5 x 2.5 m and a 3.1 m kit figure with both arms flung up, one long arm sweeping up and west, and four flat hair tufts streaming west

items.where: a chain of thirteen thin bronze figures in two loose ranks at the west end, leaning east into the pull, arms reaching forward, bound by a rope
items.how: thirteen kit figures (1.95 m, thin, striding, lean 0.34 rad, yaw east) at positions read from the Ceescamel F and RoMaVo 1 photographs, with a rope rod from each waist to the next walker's hand; individual faces are not modelled

items.where: low dark-grey concrete platform carrying the groups, on a round paved apron
items.how: builder: a box 11 x 4.5 x 0.75 m on a 12.4 m disc

walls.note: Rear side seen in the Ceescamel and Arthena photographs: the same platform edge, the figures from behind.

sources.name: RoMaVo, Erwin de Vries - Nationaal Monument Slavernijverleden (Commons)
